answer_1.quote: We prompt the models with the following template: Paraphrase this text: "{text}" ...

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation focuses on three aspects: ... realism of the synthetic data, ... hate speech label preservation, ... representation of target identities ... Annotators were provided with a sample ... and asked whether each example appears to be written by a human or an LLM ... they also annotated grammaticality, presence of hate speech, and presence of identity mentions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to assess realism (could the message be a real social media post), grammaticality, world knowledge/plausibility, hate speech presence, and identity category mentions.
